text:
sarah-partners: Quick heads-up — I want to rebalance FY26 MDF allocation toward marketplace & SI enablement. Need updated partner scorecards before the upcoming quarterly reviews. Proposed global split (starter): 60% enablement / 30% co-marketing / 10% trial credits. Thoughts?

miguel-sales: 60/30/10 OK as baseline but recommend tiered allocation. Platinum should skew more to enablement (70/20/10), mid-tier more marketing.

anya-gpm: +1 on tiered. I'm drafting Scorecard v2 to include: Marketplace listing health, joint-announcement readiness, enablement hours logged, and funnel conversion. Will share a doc link shortly: https://redwood-internal/docs/partner-scorecard-v2

emily-finance: We need hard counts per tier before I can reforecast MDF. Also propose we attach a minimum revenue or ARR commit to qualify for each MDF tier.

miguel-sales: Quick partner counts (prelim): Platinum 12, Gold 35, Silver 110. I'll upload the partner CSV to the shared drive: https://drive.redwood/partnerships/partner-counts.csv

anya-gpm: Draft metrics example (v0.1):
```
Tier,score_threshold,marketplace_health,enablement_hours,marketing_fund_usd
Platinum,85,>90%,40,120000
Gold,70,>75%,20,45000
Silver,55,>60%,8,10000
```

sarah-partners: Nice. For MDF policy, let's define: credit usage window = 6 months, co-fund require joint asset (blog + webinar), enablement credits redeemable as dev hours or training vouchers.

ops-bot: Reminder: joint-announcement checklist template posted to #partnerships > assets — https://redwood-internal/templates/announcement-checklist (automated)

emily-finance: Timeline I can support: if I get final partner counts by Tue noon I can run a draft reforecast by Thu EOD and finalize by Fri. Will need a proposed tiering policy from Product/GTMs by Wed.

miguel-sales: I'll deliver final counts + suggested tier mapping by Mon 5pm; will include historical MDF utilization for top 20 partners.

anya-gpm: I'll share Scorecard v0.1 by Mon 3pm and v0.2 after your counts. Also adding a 'marketplace readiness' checklist to the scorecard.

sarah-partners: Schedule — can we lock a 30m ops sync Tues 10am? Goal: agree tier policy + sign off scorecard v0.2 so finance can freeze numbers.

emily-finance: Tue 10am works for me.

miguel-sales: Works.

anya-gpm: Works.

sarah-partners: Action items recap: @miguel-sales -> final counts + tier mapping (Mon 5pm); @anya-gpm -> scorecard v0.1 (Mon 3pm) then v0.2 (after counts); @emily-finance -> draft reforecast (Thu), final (Fri). I'll own policy doc and announcement sequencing. :thumbsup:

miguel-sales: noted. Adding historical MDF spend per partner to the sheet.

anya-gpm: I'll add a short eval harness so we can monitor quality/regressions post-announce (simple prompt set + conversion metric).

sarah-partners: Perfect. We'll use this thread to track decisions — will post meeting invite and attach the scorecard link once v0.1 is up.

ops-bot: Calendar invite created: Partner Ops — Tiering & Scorecards — Tue 10:00 (link: https://meet.redwood/abcd1234)

sarah-partners: Thanks all — let's keep customer-facing comms aligned with the joint announcement checklist.
